title: Two Sum with Multiple Targets
statement: Given an array of integers nums and a list of targets, return the indices of the numbers that add up to each target.
hints: Use a dictionary to store the indices of the numbers
Iterate through the array and check if the difference between the target and the current number is in the dictionary
explanation: This variant maintains the same algorithmic reasoning as the original problem but with a list of targets.

title: Two Sum with Duplicate Pairs
statement: Given an array of integers nums and an integer target, return all pairs of indices of the two numbers such that they add up to target, including duplicate pairs.
hints: Use a dictionary to store the numbers and their indices
Iterate through the array only once
explanation: This variant requires the candidate to return all pairs of indices, including duplicate pairs.
